newsitem.title: MEXICO: RUSSIANS WELCOME TEQUILA ON VODKA TURF -INDUSTRY.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIANS WELCOME TEQUILA ON VODKA TURF -INDUSTRY.

text.p: Russian drinkers are taking their first tentative steps away from vodka and towards tequila, an industry spokesman said on Thursday.
"We have begun to make inroads in Russia and tequila has been welcomed there," said Jorge Camacho, vice-president of the Tequila Industry Chamber.
Camacho said "two or three" containers with 3,000 cases each of tequila have been shipped to Russia since June.
Tequila is distilled from agave cactus plants which need to be cultivated for eight years, and was traditionally favored by hard-drinking macho men in rough bars, or cantinas.

In recent years, however, tequila has found its way to yuppie restaurant tables in Mexico and abroad, and a bewildering variety of expensive brands has sprouted in storefronts alongside the handful of names formally available.
